name: GR 5 Lorraine
description_md:
This waymarked hiking route in France spans a distance of 293.0 km. The GR 5 Lorraine requires about 89 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

This hard route is part of the international waymarked hiking network. Walkers face 5999 m of ascent and 5365 m of descent along the journey. The trail passes Metz Cathedral within 100 m, Metz within 200 m, and Medieval houses in Metz within 200 m.
